summary.text: Kent Roberson is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 25, appointed in 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Roberson was appointed to the House of Delegates on May 5, 2023, to replace Darryl Barnes, and assumed office on May 31, 2023.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists his committee assignment as the Ways & Means Committee.
